show.description:
Naganna, a humble vegetable vendor in Bangalore, hides a brilliant past as a top economist.
His son Rachith, ashamed of their poverty, faces a shocking truth that changes everything.
When corporate greed and betrayal strike, only Naganna’s wisdom can save his son’s dream.
A powerful story of pride, family and redemption unfolds.
Watch Rich Blood, Poor Life now — only on Kuku TV!
